style: cinematic 3D cartoon, Pixar-quality fur, slapstick, deadpan

shot.continuity: one continuous take, camera moving every beat, no cuts

subject.character: tall red deer stag, branching antlers, deadpan eyes
subject.physicality: body rocks each stride, steady chew, ears flick when startled
subject.secondary_character: red-capped woodpecker on the trunk beside the stag, large and close to camera, pecking its own notice
subject.tertiary_character: small red fox, deep background, holding its own notice

props.notice: stag's tax notice: blank paper, faint red stamp, nailed into bark by his face, one support — the trunk, torn edge, nothing floating
props.woodpecker_notice: second identical notice, same stamp, nailed higher on the trunk
props.fox_notice: fox's own notice, same stamp, folded into a paper airplane
props.grass_tuft: tuft of dry grass torn from the ground, stays in his mouth

environment: sunlit birch clearing, midday, dry grass, bare dirt, clean air
lighting: hard midday sun, dappled shadow from birch trunks, high-contrast daylight

light_events.event: the swinging notice and the fox's paper airplane catch a last glint of sun

audio.language: Russian, exactly the words in the line fields
audio.delivery: male, low warm chest voice ~130 Hz, dry deadpan, measured, never rushed, native Russian, no accent, @Voice: Sadachbia
audio.pacing: seven lines in four groups, each in its own tight window
audio.lip_sync: mouth moves each syllable, jaw keeps chewing, voice is the stag's own

timeline.a: Gallop bursts from the birches, hard skid, dust flying; yanks a grass tuft into his mouth. Background: fox trots in with its notice
timeline.cam: push in, brake, settle on muzzle

timeline.a: Shoulder rolls through sunlight, neck stretches, antlers catch light. Background: fox folds its notice into an airplane
Woodpecker lands on the trunk, drums its own notice nailed higher up — scraps fly on the first strike. Stag keeps chewing, head turned away
drumming continues; at the tail the fifth strike lands, ears flick back, drumming stops
timeline.cam: back to muzzle, woodpecker at edge

timeline.line: найдёт (nai-DYOT — stress on the second syllable, never NAI-dyot)
timeline.a: forest quiet, ears finish the flick, jaw keeps chewing
forest silent, finishes chewing, gaze on lens
Frame opens on the trunk — his notice nailed into the bark. He freezes, tuft in mouth, eyes sliding to the notice
Notice peels off, swings from his antler as he resumes chewing; background: fox flings its airplane up, arcing into the sky

negative_prompt: night, dusk, evening light, lamp, candle, neon, dim, moody lighting, dark scene, underexposed, haze, fog, mist; floating notices, a fourth notice, duplicate props; second stag, woodpecker, or fox, other animals, human hand; subtitles, captions, text overlays, watermark; English speech, rushed delivery, gaps inside a line, mouth stopping mid-chew; cuts, jump cuts, static or locked camera, whip pan, snap zoom; extra limbs, appearance changing mid-shot, horizontal framing
